title: Rubio Says Incident at UK Air Base RAF Fairford ‘Clearly Involved’ a Foreign Actor
summary: The U.S. secretary of state, Marco Rubio, told Fox News that what happened at a base used by U.S. bombers flying to Iran was “very serious,” without providing details.
